changelog: Initial release: browse, search, download, export, upload, share, and organize Google Drive files via Composio-managed OAuth. 20+ commands with JSON output.
summary: Browse Google Drive folders and read the files inside them. Use when the user points at a Drive folder or file, asks for data stored in Drive (CSV/Excel/PDF exports, shared reports), or wants files organised, uploaded, or shared in Drive. Uses Composio for OAuth so no client-side Google credentials are needed.
